Always use caution and work closely with physicians or pharmacists 
to ensure that there are no egg ingredients in any of the following:
•	 Cosmetics
•	 Medications
•	 Vaccines
•	 Albumin or chicken serum can be used in any vaccine
•	 Influenza vaccines
•	 MMR: measles, mumps, rubella vaccine
•	 Rabies vaccine may contain small amounts
•	 Typhus vaccine may contain small amounts
•	 Yellow fever vaccine
